observations:
Coverage: 12 screenshots, each showing a different one of the 12 listed reports selected, in list order (1.PNG Peg Board Day Sheet, 2 Daily Journal, 3 Production Report, 4 Collection Report, 5 Deposit Slip, 6 Scheduled Production = left column; 7 Routing Slip, 8 Progress Notes, 9 Production Analysis Report, 10 Daily Audit, 11 Claims Printed, 12 Special Transaction Report = right column). The selected radio of every screenshot was confirmed from the pixels. There are no popups, expanded dropdowns, scrolled second views or foreign screens, so the contents of every SELECT / SEARCH picker dialog and of the two dropdown lists (Amount on Special Transaction Report, Fee Schedule To Compare on Production Report) are NOT documented by these screenshots.

Screen chrome (identical in all 12): dark title bar with 'Daily Reports' at the left and 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon at the far right. Blue sub-header 'SELECT REPORT' over the left panel and 'REPORT CRITERIA' over the right panel; the right end of the REPORT CRITERIA bar holds the grey-styled CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon). A splitter / collapse handle with three vertical dots sits between the two panels. The bottom action bar of the criteria panel holds PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon), both blue.

Report list: 12 radio items in a 2-column x 6-row grid; the dark panel below the grid is empty (checked pixel by pixel), so the list is not scrollable or clipped.

Text-rendering caveat: the bold dark section-header font draws a capital G almost exactly like a C at this resolution (the partly visible footer message suggests the page was captured at 75% browser zoom), so the pixels look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DATE RANCE', 'CROUP BY', 'PROCRESS NOTES TO PRINT', 'BUT MISSINC', 'CATECORY', 'CODE/CATECORY', 'PATIENT NAME RANCE'. The greyed 'GROUP BATCH CHECKS' header on Deposit Slip and the mixed-case labels ('Office Group', 'Group By') show a clear G, so all of these are transcribed with G. The date digits '11' also render like 'TI' (the value is 11/21/2026).

Recurring patterns: PRINT FORMAT (PDF | Excel, default PDF) is on 11 of 12 reports - missing only on Routing Slip. REPORT FORMAT (Detail | Summary) appears only on Daily Journal, Production Report (Detail greyed, Summary selected), Collection Report and Claims Printed; Production Analysis Report has ANALYSIS BY in that slot. OFFICE/GROUP (Office | Office Group radios, default Office, plus an unlabelled read-only box showing 108 = the current OID with a SELECT button) is on all 12; Office Group is greyed only on Routing Slip. A PROVIDER picker (default ALL) is on 10 reports - Production Report and Collection Report have none - and a User picker is added (section title PROVIDER/USER) on Daily Journal, Deposit Slip and Special Transaction Report; Progress Notes labels its provider row 'Preferred Provider'. Every date field shows 11/21/2026 (the capture day, i.e. the default is today); Peg Board Day Sheet has a single Report Date instead of a Start Date / End Date range. A date-basis radio precedes the range on Daily Journal (Transaction Date | Created Date), Deposit Slip (Transaction Date | Payment Date), Progress Notes (DOS Date | Created On Date | Appointment Date) and Special Transaction Report (Transaction Date | Service Date). Apart from the office box (108), the read-only picker boxes (grey fill + blue SELECT) default to ALL, except EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE and PAYMENT/ADJ CODES on Special Transaction Report which default to 'None'. A small 'Page Break' checkbox sits alone in the right half of the grouping row on Daily Journal, Production Report, Collection Report and Daily Audit and is greyed in every screenshot (grouping = None in all of them). Button icons: building icon for office / codes / payment types / payment-adj codes / insurance plans / code-category; single-person icon for provider / operatory / category / carrier(s); person-plus icon for user and exclude patient type; magnifier for SEARCH; circle-slash for NONE.

Disabled states were confirmed by pixel colour: disabled labels are mid-grey (RGB 161) against black for enabled ones; read-only / disabled boxes are grey (220,223,226) against (241,241,241) for editable fields. Controls greyed in the captured default state (what enables them is not shown): Show AR and Page Break (Daily Journal); Detail, Page Break, Include Z-Codes and the Fee Schedule To Compare dropdown (Production Report); Page Break (Collection Report); CHECK TYPE and the whole GROUP BATCH CHECKS block (Deposit Slip); Office Group (Routing Slip); Appointment Date and APPOINTMENTS TO INCLUDE (Progress Notes); the CARRIER SELECT button (Production Analysis Report); Page Break (Daily Audit); Age Range From / To and the amount value box (Special Transaction Report).

Truncation: the criteria area has a fixed height (about 481 px in every screenshot) with the action bar pinned below it and no scrollbar is ever drawn. Daily Journal (2.PNG) is visibly clipped - its GROUP BY row is cut by the action bar - and Special Transaction Report (12.PNG) fills the area exactly with its last row flush against (and about 2-3 px short at) the action bar, so both are flagged possibly_truncated; in both cases the overflow is only a few pixels, which is consistent with the visible row being the last one, but hidden rows cannot be ruled out. The other ten reports show blank space under their last section.

Footer: only 2.PNG shows a sliver of the page footer, and only the top 3-4 pixel rows of the glyphs are visible, so it cannot be read reliably. Best reading: '© 2026 Planet DDS | Privacy Policy | ... [?]' in black (Privacy Policy in link blue, followed by further unreadable text ending in digits) and, in red at the right, 'You have zoomed ... to 75%. This page is best viewed if zoomed to 100% [?]'. It is browser-zoom chrome of the host page, not report criteria.

Verification: third-reader pass over the original PNGs and enlarged crops. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option, default and enabled state (151 controls); their only differences were descriptive (SELECT icon wording, the label given to the Routing Slip info icon, the wording of the unreadable footer). A pixel-cluster sweep of every criteria panel found no control outside those listed here.
